note: Provincial park campground in the woods on the shore of Saskatoon Lake, 21 km west of Grande Prairie off Hwy 43 and 4 km north on an access road. Most RV sites are posted for equipment up to 21 ft; only six take 31 ft (power sites A-11, A-23 and C-75; unserviced B-49, C-91 and C-94), so a 23-ft rig must book one of those. Walk-in tent sites along the shoreline. --Claude
